mapper.update: UPDATE artist_registry_lock SET revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1
mapper.sql: SELECT a.*,p.version AS portrait_version,b.version AS background_version,p.origin AS portrait_origin,b.origin AS background_origin,p.source_url AS portrait_source,b.source_url AS background_source,p.attribution AS portrait_attribution,b.attribution AS background_attribution,pf.state AS portrait_fetch_state,bf.state AS background_fetch_state FROM artist a LEFT JOIN artist_image p ON p.artist_id=a.id AND p.image_kind='PORTRAIT' LEFT JOIN artist_image b ON b.artist_id=a.id AND b.image_kind='BACKGROUND' LEFT JOIN artist_image_fetch pf ON pf.artist_id=a.id AND pf.image_kind='PORTRAIT' LEFT JOIN artist_image_fetch bf ON bf.artist_id=a.id AND bf.image_kind='BACKGROUND'
mapper.select: WHERE a.name_key IS NULL ORDER BY a.id
mapper.update: UPDATE artist SET name=#{input.name},aliases_json=#{aliases},artist_type=#{input.type},biography=#{input.biography},active=#{input.active},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{input.revision}
mapper.select: SELECT artist_id,revision FROM artist_credit_binding WHERE song_id=#{song} AND credit_name=#{credit}
mapper.update: UPDATE artist_credit_binding SET artist_id=#{artist},revision=revision+1 WHERE song_id=#{song} AND credit_name=#{credit} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT i.*,a.active FROM artist_image i JOIN artist a ON a.id=i.artist_id WHERE i.artist_id=#{id} AND i.image_kind=#{kind}
mapper.update: UPDATE artist_image SET version=#{version},image_bytes=#{bytes,jdbcType=BLOB} WHERE artist_id=#{id} AND image_kind=#{kind}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM artist_image WHERE artist_id=#{id} AND image_kind=#{kind}
mapper.update: UPDATE artist SET name_key=#{key}, active=1 WHERE id=#{id} AND name_key IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT artists_json,revision FROM song_artist_override WHERE source_id=#{source} AND path_key=#{path}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM song_artist_override WHERE source_id=#{source} AND path_key=#{path}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artist_image_policy WHERE artist_id=#{id} AND image_kind=#{kind} AND blocked=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM artist_image_policy WHERE artist_id=#{id} AND image_kind=#{kind}
mapper.select: SELECT id,fetch_attempts,fetch_generation FROM artist WHERE name_key IS NOT NULL AND fetch_state IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND fetch_after <= #{now} ORDER BY fetch_after,id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE artist SET fetch_state=#{state},fetch_attempts=#{attempts},fetch_after=#{after} WHERE id=#{id} AND fetch_generation=#{generation}
UPDATE artist_image SET origin=#{origin},provider=#{provider},external_id=#{external},source_url=#{url} WHERE artist_id=#{id} AND image_kind=#{kind}
UPDATE artist_image SET attribution=#{value} WHERE artist_id=#{id} AND image_kind=#{kind}
mapper.select: SELECT artist_id,image_kind,attempts,generation FROM artist_image_fetch WHERE state IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND fetch_after <= #{now} ORDER BY fetch_after,artist_id,CASE image_kind WHEN 'PORTRAIT' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1
SELECT state,attempts,generation,candidates_json FROM artist_image_fetch WHERE artist_id=#{id} AND image_kind=#{kind}
mapper.update: UPDATE artist_image_fetch SET candidates_json=#{value} WHERE artist_id=#{id} AND image_kind=#{kind} AND generation=#{generation}
UPDATE artist_image_fetch SET state=#{state},attempts=#{attempts},fetch_after=#{after} WHERE artist_id=#{id} AND image_kind=#{kind} AND generation=#{generation}
UPDATE artist_image_fetch SET state='PENDING',attempts=0,fetch_after='',generation=generation+1,candidates_json=NULL WHERE artist_id=#{id} AND image_kind=#{kind}
mapper.select: SELECT fanart_key_encrypted FROM artist_artwork_settings WHERE id=1
mapper.update: UPDATE artist_artwork_settings SET fanart_key_encrypted=#{encrypted} WHERE id=1

UPDATE artist_image_fetch SET state='PENDING',attempts=0,fetch_after='',generation=generation+1 WHERE image_kind='BACKGROUND' AND state IN ('NO_MATCH','FAILED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM artist_image i WHERE i.artist_id=artist_image_fetch.artist_id AND i.image_kind='BACKGROUND') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM artist_image_policy p WHERE p.artist_id=artist_image_fetch.artist_id AND p.image_kind='BACKGROUND' AND p.blocked=1)
